name: B10-0435/2026 – After § 25 – Am 11
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the state of play of advancing EU-Africa trade and investment relations
part_text: 25a. Calls for investor-state dispute settlement mechanisms to be phased out in bilateral investment treaties between EU Member States and African countries; stresses the need to preserve full policy space to regulate and pursue social and environmental development objectives;
